---
id: eagle
title: Eagle Landing
archive: orbital
summary: Eagle landed on the Sea of Tranquility while Michael Collins stayed in Columbia.
entities: Eagle; Michael Collins; Sea of Tranquility; Columbia
---

Eagle was the lunar module that landed on the Sea of Tranquility. Neil Armstrong and Buzz Aldrin climbed down onto the surface after the landing. Michael Collins stayed in lunar orbit aboard the command module Columbia and kept the ship ready for the rendezvous. Columbia was the only part of the spacecraft that returned to Earth. The landing site is still called the Sea of Tranquility, and Collins never walked on the surface during that flight.
